note: Registry of open datasets that can back the shape library.
Every record here was supplied by the user and has NOT been verified
against the live repository: record identifiers, licences and case counts
are claims until tools/fetch_datasets.py checks them at download time,
which is why each carries metadata_verified: false. The fetcher re-reads
the licence from the repository API and refuses the download when it
disagrees with what is written here.
Demographics are recorded as 'not published' where the dataset does not
state them. They are not estimated, because an invented sex split or age
range would defeat the purpose of showing the cohort to the user.
